svg.title: O for OOH and Transit Advertising
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold O becomes a circular road surrounding a billboard while a wrapped bus travels along the road. It introduces out-of-home and transit advertising, with illustrative billboard, bus and street-shelter examples.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop; reimagines the O and cream, black, cyan, magenta and yellow palette of 15_O_offset_printing.png; no external assets. All advertising examples are fictional concepts.
